title: AlertSourceCapability
description: One source of an alert type, as it relates to a selection of sources.

canJoin.description: False when adding this source to the selection would break a rule. The form disables it and shows the reason.

reason.description: Why the source cannot join the selection.

warning.description: For a selected source: why, with what has been chosen so far, it can never produce a match. The alert still saves.
